claim: An Availability Zone is one or more discrete data centers, each with redundant power, networking and connectivity, housed in separate facilities, so that a fire, tornado or flood affects only a single Availability Zone.
question: What is an Availability Zone in one sentence?

values.display: one or more discrete data centers, each with redundant power, networking, and connectivity, and housed in separate facilities
values.spoken: an Availability Zone is one or more separate data centers with their own redundant power, networking and connectivity

values.display: only a single Availability Zone would be affected

evidence.quote: Each Availability Zone consists of one or more discrete data centers, each with redundant power, networking, and connectivity, and housed in separate facilities. Because they are physically separate, only a single Availability Zone would be affected in the unlikely event of a fire, tornado, or flooding.
An Availability Zone is one or more discrete data centers with separate and redundant power infrastructure, networking, and connectivity in an AWS Region.

claim: AWS services process and store customer content in the Region or Regions where the customer uses the services; the named global services (IAM, Organizations, CloudFront, Route53, Global Accelerator, Direct Connect, Firewall Manager, WAF, Shield) may store and process data globally.
question: Does AWS move customer content out of the Region the customer chose?

values.display: process and store customer content in the AWS region(s) where the services are used by the customer
values.spoken: customer content stays in the Region where you use the service

values.display: may store and process data globally

evidence.quote: AWS services process and store customer content in the AWS region(s) where the services are used by the customer. Except as otherwise specified, Global Services—AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), AWS Organizations, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Route53, AWS Global Accelerator, AWS Direct Connect, AWS Firewall Manager, AWS Web Application Firewall (WAF), and AWS Shield—may store and process data globally.
